{
  "name": "plan-usage",
  "displayName": "Plan Usage",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Shows your Claude plan's session and weekly limits above the prompt, gives Claude a plan_usage tool to check them without a model call, and can pause a long-running session before the session limit and continue after it resets.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Brian Potter",
    "url": "https://github.com/potterdigital"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/potterdigital/plan-usage-mod",
  "repository": "https://github.com/potterdigital/plan-usage-mod",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "usage",
    "rate-limits",
    "plan",
    "status",
    "overnight"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "warn_at": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Warning level (percent)",
      "description": "From this percent of a limit, the band turns orange and reads HIGH.",
      "default": 80,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 100
    },
    "show_at": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Show from (percent)",
      "description": "Show a limit on the line only once it reaches this percent. 0 shows it always.",
      "default": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 100
    },
    "time_zone": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Time zone",
      "description": "IANA time zone for reset times, such as America/Chicago. Leave empty to use this computer's.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "auto_pause": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Pause near the session limit",
      "description": "When the session limit reaches the threshold, let running tool calls finish, stop the turn, and continue 2 minutes after the limit resets.",
      "default": false
    },
    "pause_threshold": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Pause threshold (percent)",
      "description": "Session-limit percent that starts the pause when it is on.",
      "default": 95,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 100
    },
    "resume_prompt": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Resume prompt",
      "description": "What the session is sent when it continues after a pause.",
      "default": "Plan usage reset; resume where you left off from the files on disk."
    }
  }
}
